about.title: About me
about.bio: Hello! My name is Gabriel and I am a constantly evolving front-end developer. Since graduating in Mechatronics Engineering, I have dedicated myself to studying and practicing web development tools and languages, with an emphasis on React. My mission is to use my knowledge and skills to create interfaces and technologies that make a real difference in people's lives. I am always open to new challenges and learning opportunities, and I look forward to contributing to incredible projects in the future. If you'd like to chat, feel free to reach out on my social media—it will be a pleasure! 👋
